AI Overview
You can play popular Duck Life games—including Duck Life 2, Duck Life 4, and Duck Life Space—directly on Math Playground. 
What is Duck Life?
Core Gameplay: You raise and train a duckling in skills like running, flying, swimming, and climbing to win races, earn coins, and unlock new worlds.
Math Integration: On Math Playground, the games combine skill training and resource management with strategic decision-making and math-based mini-games or puzzle elements.

Available Versions on Math Playground
Duck Life 2: World Champion: Train your duck across different regions to win races and save the farm.
Duck Life 4: Compete across 6 themed worlds (from grassland to volcanoes), level up skills up to 150, and collect coins.
Duck Life Space: Manage resources, energy, and speed in a space-themed training adventure.
